◆ mathUtils_getValidFFTSize()

uint32_t mathUtils_getValidFFTSize ( uint32_t  numSamples)

Description
Function to return the best FFT size with respect to the HWA. HWA supports FFT sizes 2^x and 3*(2^x). This function checks which among 2^x or 3*(2^y) is closest to the given input and returns that value. This would ensure that zero padding is as less as possible.

Parameters
[in]numSamplesNumber of input samples.
Return values
Bestsuited FFT size.
